slides.heading: What it is
paras: The core mechanic: at the end of every Claude Code session, Claude rewrites primer.md with a snapshot of where the project currently stands and what the next session should do first.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: claude --debug logs across exit, /compact, and multi-turn sessions: exactly one rewrite per exit and per compaction, zero per turn, zero recursive.
lint_primer.py passes on 10 consecutive automatic rewrites, and its 8-fixture test suite returns 8/8 expected results.
